network.description: Outbound network access: none cuts the step off from every network, egress allows it. Empty means egress for now.

command.description: Command and arguments, run without a shell. Set this or run, not both.

env.description: Environment variables for the step. Names must be valid identifiers.

id.description: Unique step identifier: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.

image.description: Container image the step runs in.

inputs.description: Workspace-relative file globs that make up the step's cache key. A step without inputs is never cached.

needs.description: IDs of steps that must succeed before this one starts.

permissions.description: What the step is allowed to do. See docs/design/005-threat-model.md.

run.description: Shell script to run. Set this or command, not both.

timeout.description: Maximum run time as a duration such as 30s or 10m. Must be positive.

workdir.description: Absolute working directory inside the container.

description: A Forgeline pipeline, spec version v1alpha1.

name.description: Pipeline name: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.

steps.description: The steps to run. At least one is required.

title: Forgeline pipeline
